summary: Monster ecology 'chase' action (ecoCh): a 0x44-byte polymorphic action object owned by a monster actor's ecology list; it waits for its target, spins the owner toward it and winds the spin down. Same object as Field_NpcAction_Chase (batch S_037) - the generated Map_Object name comes from the misnamed maybe_Map_Object_UpdatePlacementScale guess and is not a map object.
evidence: Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor (0x004D6F24) installs vtable 0x00779E30 and is called with a 0x44-byte block from Monster_SetupEcology (0x00178B08: Mem_AllocAligned_2(0x44,...) then s_ecoCh); it chains through Monster_AiBehavior_Ctor -> Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4, so +0..+0x2B is a Gfx_ObjectDesc header. Same object as Field_NpcAction_Chase (S_037).

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor (0x004D6F24) stores 0x00779E30 at +0; the slots are Field_NpcAction_Chase_Dtor (0x004D6F6C), this class's start (0x004D6BB8), 0x004D6F20 and Field_NpcAction_Chase_Update (0x004D6C54)

fields.name: ownerActor
fields.evidence: the actor the action drives: Map_PlaceObject(ownerActor,0), Field_NpcPlayActionAnim(ownerActor,'ChaseLoop'), Field_NpcPlayAnimation(ownerActor,6/7); its rotation quaternion +0x8C..+0x98 and local offset +0x100..+0x108 are read and written; Container_FindObjectByTypeId reads ownerActor+0x2C0 (link handle) and Monster_SetupEcology stores the ecology record at ownerActor+0x2C4

fields.name: actionState
fields.evidence: byte: cleared by the start method and by Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor (strb #0), set to 1 and 2 by Field_NpcAction_Chase_Update, which switches on it (0 = wait for target, 1 = spin toward target and play 'ChaseEnd', 2 = wind the spin down and play animation 7)

fields.name: startDistance
fields.evidence: float copied from the actor's ecology record (ownerActor+0x2C4->+0x1C), default 1.0f in Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor; state 0 advances only while startDistance <= the action limit self->f_24->+0x44. The sibling RunToLink action reads the same record field as a delay, so this may be a time rather than a distance

fields.name: endDistanceDelta
fields.evidence: float copied from the actor's ecology record (ownerActor+0x2C4->+0x24), default 2.0f in Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor; added to startDistance to form the bound that ends the chase (state 1 -> 2 when startDistance + endDistanceDelta <= self->f_24->+0x44)

fields.name: chaseSpeed
fields.evidence: float rate: multiplied by the frame delta time to scale the orbit step written to ownerActor+0x100..+0x108; decays by 0.1f per frame (clamped at 0) in state 2; default 4.05f in Monster_Action_EcoChase_Ctor, then overwritten from the global at 0x0063E650(dataManager)+4
